packageRules.description: jetty-bom stays on 12.0.x. The pom imports it only to override the test-scoped Jetty that wiremock-jetty12 pulls in, for CVE patches. wiremock-jetty12 3.13.2 imports jetty-bom AND jetty-ee10-bom at 12.0.30, and our dependencyManagement overrides only jetty-bom. A bump to 12.1.x therefore puts jetty-util 12.1.x next to jetty-ee10-servlet 12.0.30, whose ServletContextHandler class initializer calls the static Environment.ensure(String) that Jetty 12.1 removed. Every WireMock test then dies with NoSuchMethodError. Lift this pin once WireMock ships a Jetty 12.1 build.
